privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.metaDescription: What data this site collects, what it is used for, and how long it is kept.
privacy.description: This page explains what this site actually does with your data.

dataCollected.title: Data collected
dataCollected.body:
Only the data you type into the contact form yourself: name, email address, company name (optional), subject (optional), message body, and the page language at the time of sending.

Visitor IP addresses are not stored.

purpose.title: How the data is used
purpose.body: Contact form data is used only to reply to your message. It is not sold, not shared with third parties, and not used for marketing.

retention.title: Retention
retention.body: Messages are stored in the site database until the site owner deletes them. You can request deletion at any time through the contact form.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.body: This site stores only your display preferences: language choice and light/dark theme choice. There are no tracking cookies and no third-party cookies.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.body: This site currently uses no analytics service at all. If one is added later, this page is updated first.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: You may request a copy, a correction, or the deletion of any data you have sent through the contact form. Send the request through that same form.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.metaDescription: Terms of use for the content of this portfolio and Knowledge Base.
terms.description: Brief terms regarding the use of this site's content.

usage.title: Use of the site
usage.body: This site contains a portfolio and technical documentation for informational purposes. You may read, save, and quote its content for personal use or recruitment evaluation.

content.title: Rights to the content
content.body: All text, documents, and images on this site are the work of the site owner unless stated otherwise. Reuse for commercial purposes requires written permission.

labDisclaimer.title: Lab scenarios and configurations
labDisclaimer.body:
Documents marked as lab scenarios were produced in a simulated environment; they are not records of production incidents.

Every configuration and command shown is an example for a test environment. Applying them to a production network is your own responsibility.

liability.title: Limitation of liability
liability.body: The content of this site is provided as is, without any guarantee that each step will work in your environment. The site owner is not liable for any loss arising from use of this content.
